name: eGuarantee, Inc.
summary: eGuarantee, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in credit risk entrustment and securitization business in Japan. It offers services for business corporations that include undertaking the risk of uncollected receivables arising between business companies, such as contracts and contract work. The company also provides services for financial institutions, including service to accept the risks associated with financial receivables from credit card companies and other companies that handle advance payments to corporations and affiliated companies.
